serverError: Something went wrong on the server.
permissionDenied: Only the overlord can do that.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Even villains must wait {{seconds}} seconds.
validation.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like henchman@lair.example
validation.mustBeNumber: Enter a number. Roman numerals are not supported.
validation.dateInPast: The deadline can't be in the past. Even our time machine needs notice.
fileTypeNotAllowed: Only PNG, JPG and PDF files can be uploaded. Blueprints on napkins must be scanned first.
uploadInterrupted: The upload was interrupted. Probably the minions tripped over the cable.
deviceQuota_one: Your plan allows {{count}} doomsday device. Upgrade to Overlord to build more.
deviceQuota_other: Your plan allows {{count}} doomsday devices. Upgrade to Overlord to build more.
storageFull: Your lair's storage is full. Archive old schemes or delete unused blueprints to free up space. Uploads will stay paused until you are back under the limit, but everything already stored is safe.
deathRayCooldown: The death ray is cooling down. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing
conflictHelp: {{name}} saved a newer version of this scheme a moment ago. Reload to see their changes, then apply yours again. Nothing has been lost, but only one plan for world domination can win.
timeoutHelp: The server didn't answer in time. It may be busy, or a hero may have cut a wire again. Your changes are kept in this tab, so wait a moment and try again.
maintenanceBody: We're upgrading the volcano and reinforcing the secret tunnels. The app will be back by {{time}} ({{timezone}}). Your schemes, minions and devices are safe, and nothing you saved before the downtime will be lost.
readOnlyMode: The app is read-only during maintenance
openedElsewhere: This lair is open in another tab. Changes there may overwrite yours.
deviceOffline: {{device}} is offline. Check its power supply, or its moat.
heroDetected: Action blocked: a hero is in the lair
schemeFoiled: This scheme was foiled by {{hero}} and can no longer be edited
paymentRequired: Your Overlord plan has lapsed. Renew to keep scheming.
featureUnavailable: This feature isn't available on your plan
somethingBroke: Something broke. A minion has been sent to investigate.
offlineBanner: You're offline. Changes will sync when the connection returns.
